clause_path: Sec. 4(a)(1)(A) reserves at least 1 to 1; categories (i) to (viii)

obligations.label: a permitted payment stablecoin issuer must maintain identifiable reserves backing its outstanding payment stablecoins on an at least 1 to 1 basis
permitted reserve category (i): US coins and currency (Federal Reserve notes included) and money credited to accounts at a Federal Reserve Bank
permitted reserve category (ii): demand deposits or other withdrawable-on-request deposits, or insured shares at an insured depository institution, subject to safety-and-soundness limitations
permitted reserve category (iii): short-dated Treasury obligations (bills, notes, bonds) whose remaining or original issue maturity is 93 days or less
permitted reserve category (iv): money received under repurchase agreements with an overnight maturity, the issuer as seller, backed by Treasury bills with a maturity of 93 days or less

permitted reserve category (v): overnight reverse repurchase agreements collateralized by Treasury notes, bills, or bonds with overcollateralization in line with standard market terms, held tri-party, centrally cleared through a registered clearing agency, or bilateral with a counterparty deemed creditworthy under severe market stress
permitted reserve category (vi): securities of a registered investment company or other registered government money market fund invested solely in assets described in categories (i) through (v)

permitted reserve category (vii): any other comparably liquid asset issued by the Federal Government that the primary Federal stablecoin regulator approves, consulting the State regulator where applicable
permitted reserve category (viii): any reserve described in categories (i) through (iii) or (vi) through (vii) held in tokenized form, provided it complies with all applicable laws and regulations
